fact: NISR announced on 6 January 2026 by press release that the seventh Rwanda Demographic and Health Survey, 2025 RDHS, was released.
NISR states the Fifth Rwanda Population and Housing Census was enumerated in fieldwork from 16 to 30 August 2022; a Main Indicators Report followed in February 2023.

The final report of the 2025 Rwanda Demographic and Health Survey (seventh round), run by NISR with the Ministry of Health and ICF and covering over 14,000 households nationwide, was published; the document gives its date as August 2026 (cover reads June 2026).
